title: [review] messaging.py:151: Duplicate explicit message IDs
description: When a POST provides an explicit 'id' that already exists, line 150 overwrites the message in _sent, but lines 151-152 don't add to _sent_order since msg_id is already present. This allows silent message replacement without any indication to the caller. If this is intended idempotency, it should be documented; if not, duplicate IDs should return CONFLICT.
